ig_caption:
Think every tax move for 2026 has to happen by Dec 31? Some can wait until April.

Myth vs fact:
✔️ Must be done by Dec 31: equipment has to be in use, and gifts to charity paid (a check counts the day you mail it).
✔️ Can wait: IRA money for 2026 can go in until Apr 15, 2027. The limit is $7,500, or $8,600 if you're 50 or older.
✔️ Can wait: HSA money for 2026, also until Apr 15, 2027 with an HSA-eligible plan. $4,400 self-only, $8,750 family.
✔️ Can wait even longer: a SEP-IRA, up to your return due date, extension included.

In a year-end session we split your list: before Dec 31, and before April.

li_caption:
Not every tax move for 2026 has to happen by Dec 31. Mixing them up leads to rushed December decisions.

Myth vs fact:

1. Must be done by Dec 31: business equipment has to be placed in service, meaning ready and available for use, not just ordered.
2. Must be done by Dec 31: charitable gifts have to be made. A check counts on the date you mail it.
3. Can wait: IRA contributions for 2026 can be made until the return due date, Apr 15, 2027, not including extensions. The 2026 limit is $7,500, plus $1,100 at age 50 or older.
4. Can wait: HSA contributions for 2026 are also allowed until Apr 15, 2027, for people with HSA-eligible coverage. The limits are $4,400 self-only and $8,750 family.
5. Can wait longer: a SEP-IRA can be set up and funded up to the return due date, including extensions.

The useful step this month: split the list into what must happen this year and what can wait for final numbers. That is what we do in a year-end planning session, using your real figures.

Comment PLAN and we will send it.

Link in the first comment.

sources.fact: 2026 IRA contribution limit $7,500; catch-up age 50+ $1,100 ($8,600 total); 401(k) $24,500
IRA contributions for a year can be made by the due date of the return, not including extensions (2026 -> Thu Apr 15, 2027)
2026 HSA limits: $4,400 self-only, $8,750 family (Rev. Proc. 2025-19 sec. 2.01)
HSA contributions for a year can be made through April 15 of the next year (Pub 969: 2025 through April 15, 2026)
SEP: contributions by the due date (including extensions) of the return; a SEP can be set up as late as that due date
Charitable contribution made at unconditional delivery; a mailed check is delivered on the date mailed
Placed in service = ready and available for a specific use
